posts.zh:
dsh-unarchive 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。恢复已归档会话：/unarchive 命令与 unarchive_session 工具，把会话移出归档集合、在原位置重新出现在工作区（归档从不删除数据）。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4296f9a97b941236b6ac.html
posts.en:
dsh-unarchive is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Restore archived sessions: a /unarchive command and an unarchive_session tool that remove sessions from the archive set so they reappear in the workspace at their original position (archiving never deletes data).

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4296f9a97b941236b6ac.html
